deck_title: Kajiya-Kay cylindrical fiber sine radical vs naive unnormalized projection darkening rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic James T. Kajiya & Timothy L. Kay (SIGGRAPH 1989) cylindrical cross-section normal integration (principal normal N0 = (L - (T.L)T) / sqrt(1 - (T.L)^2), yielding diffuse integral I_Kajiya = sqrt(1 - (T.L)^2) = sin(theta_L) and locking normalized cylindrical ratio R = 1.0000x across all 17 stations) versus naive unnormalized Gram-Schmidt projection (dotting L - (T.L)T directly with L to get 1 - (T.L)^2 = sin^2(theta_L), darkening fibers by -50.00% at theta=30 deg across 16/17 stations) and 64-slice azimuthal 3D micro-cylinder quadrature.
